introHtml: Bel mason jars bring a classic, rustic look to your branded drinkware. Unlike generic glass jars, Bel's 22 oz Fiesta Mason Jar Tumbler features a durable double-wall design that keeps drinks cold while your logo stays visible. Perfect for corporate gifts, event giveaways, or retail promotions, these jars accept screen printing or etching for a clean, professional finish.
heroAltText: Custom Bel mason jars with double-wall glass and branded logo, ideal for corporate gifts and events.
